lines.en: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
Which car was the winner in 1995?
lines.zh: 哪辆车赢得了1995年的比赛？

lines.en: There is a car race near our town every year.
lines.zh: 每年我们镇附近都有一场赛车比赛。

lines.en: In 1995, there was a very big race.
lines.zh: 1995年，那里举行了一场非常盛大的比赛。

lines.en: There were hundreds of people there.
My wife and I were at the race.
Our friends Julie and Jack were there, too.
lines.zh: 我们的朋友朱莉和杰克也在那里。

lines.en: You can see us in the crowd.
lines.zh: 你可以在人群中看到我们。

lines.en: We are standing on the left.
There were twenty cars in the race.
There were English cars, French cars, German cars, Italian cars, American cars and Japanese cars.
lines.zh: 有英国车、法国车、德国车、意大利车、美国车和日本车。
那是一个激动人心的结局。
获胜者是比利·斯图尔特。

lines.en: He was in car number fifteen.
Five other cars were just behind him.
On the way home, my wife said to me, 'Don't drive so quickly!
lines.zh: 在回家的路上，我妻子对我说：“别开那么快！
你又不是比利·斯图尔特！”
